title: agent_router.stage ubus event (what router_display relays as agent_stage)
description: Published by the agent bridge and core while a voice request is worked on. Display only: it drives the Thinking text and how long Thinking lasts on the panel and the web (docs/web_voice_mic.md); nothing is executed from it. Bridge: process before the core takes the transcript, done after every outcome. Core: answer right before a model call that writes the answer. answer and done count only with the seq of the last process. The opposite direction is the event agent_router.cancel from router_display (no required fields): the user cancelled, stop working on the request.

seq.description: The request id: the transcript's seq.
